name: Battery holder 2x 18650 (2S, 7.4 V)
source: Typical 2-cell side-by-side 18650 holder with wire leads, as sold by Keystone/shop listings; dimensions not measured
notes: Two 18650 cells in series: 7.4 V nominal (6.0-8.4 V). Red lead = +, black = -, 100 mm leads out of the -x end. Cells are side by side: the + end of one cell and the - end of the other are joined inside. Use protected cells (or a 2S BMS) and never short the leads. Charge the cells outside the holder.

electrical.source: 18650 cells at 7.4 V, 3 A continuous for protected 2600 mAh cells; typical, not yet measured
